exposure: glucose levels during 75g oral glucose tolerance test (oGTT)
cohort: 1664 patients from a gestational diabetes consultation clinic at the Charité University Hospital in Berlin, Germany
finding: Different glucose response patterns during the 75g oGTT were strongly associated with varying adverse perinatal and maternal outcomes, suggesting a need for individualized prenatal care based on these patterns.
mod_finding: Women with isolated post-load hyperglycemia (GDM-IPH) were significantly more likely to have an emergent cesarean section.
birth_weight: The offspring of GDM-IFH and GDM-CH women were born with a significantly higher mean birthweight
